en.headline: Subcontractor owner admits bribery over airport third-runway contracts
en.dek: The proprietor of Carol Engineering pleaded guilty to five charges involving more than HK$5 million while a former Airport Authority general manager denied a related conspiracy charge and went on trial.
body: The owner of a subcontractor linked to the Hong Kong International Airport Three-Runway System project pleaded guilty on Monday to five bribery charges involving more than HK$5 million, while a former Airport Authority Hong Kong executive went on trial after denying a related charge.

Ng Kai-on, 69, proprietor of Carol Engineering Limited, admitted two counts of conspiracy to offer advantages to public servants and three counts of offering advantages to agents at the District Court. His former project manager Rob Liu Wai-lun had earlier admitted two related charges. Former AAHK general manager Yin Kek-kiong, 65, denied one count of conspiracy for a public servant to accept an advantage; the hearing was adjourned to Tuesday.

The court heard that between 2017 and 2022 the company secured works packages under a main reclamation contract after Ng allegedly arranged profit shares and payments involving Yin, a former AAHK principal manager and managers of the main contractor. The Independent Commission Against Corruption said its investigation found no evidence of problems with the quality of the works. Ng and Liu were granted bail pending sentencing in March 2027.

zh.headline: 機場三跑分判商東主認串謀行賄 涉逾500萬元
zh.dek: 卡樂工程東主吳啟安承認五項行賄罪，涉款逾500萬元；機管局前總經理殷國強否認控罪受審，案件押後至周二。
body: 涉香港國際機場三跑道系統項目的分判商東主周一在區域法院承認五項行賄罪，涉款逾500萬元；機管局前總經理則否認一項相關串謀控罪，案件開始審理。
69歲卡樂工程有限公司東主吳啟安承認兩項串謀使公職人員接受利益罪及三項向代理人提供利益罪。公司前項目經理廖偉倫早前已承認兩項相關控罪。65歲機管局前總經理殷國強否認一項串謀使公職人員接受利益罪，案件由法官葉佐文審理，押後至周二續審。
案情指，2017年至2022年間，卡樂工程在主填海合約下取得多項工程，吳啟安據稱安排利潤分成及付款，涉及殷國強、一名機管局前首席經理及主承建商經理。廉政公署表示調查未發現工程質素問題。吳及廖獲准保釋，明年3月判刑。
